scope: Select a minimal live-integration set. This is not the final Auralis denoiser decision.

measured_risks.production_resampler_latency: verified: 64 samples / 1.333 ms drift-resampler delay; 2,272 samples / 47.333 ms complete processing-path structural delay

selected.decision: Integrate locally behind the common denoiser boundary; native 30-minute stability passed, but blind listening, host provenance, isolated model memory, and weight-license clarification remain before release acceptance.
Retain as the required lightweight control; do not treat it as the production-quality winner.

not_selected_for_first_live_round.reason: It shares UL-UNAS's 16 kHz, 16 ms, stateful ONNX deployment class. Its mean inference is 0.122 ms faster and clean STOI delta is 0.0165 better, but noisy SI-SDR is 1.551 dB lower and noisy STOI delta is 0.0117 lower. Retain as a measured fallback if Windows p99, clean listening, or deployment results reverse the tradeoff.

Its native 48 kHz path and 10 ms algorithmic latency are valuable, but WSL complete RTF is 0.2051, noisy STOI delta is -0.0518, clean STOI delta is -0.1214, and clean RMS change is -2.81 dB. Retain its full-band outputs for listening; do not spend the first live-integration slot on it.

unresolved_before_final_winner: No human blind responses have been recorded; only harness integrity has passed.
All candidate model-weight redistribution/commercial terms remain insufficiently explicit for shipping.
Native artifacts predate CPU model, SIMD feature, affinity, and OS-build provenance capture; runtime build/provider/thread fields are retained in the raw denoiser-runtime objects.
Weight-only model memory is not isolated; the new process RSS measurement is retained as a model-load envelope.
The frozen offline corpus lacks independent recordings for all requested noise categories; current transient controls are synthetic.
The selected clean-speech sources do not provide controlled close, medium, or far-field recording-distance labels.
